summary: The customer called to complain about their contract being auto-renewed for a full year at a higher rate without their consent, threatening to switch operators. The agent empathized, consulted a supervisor, successfully reverted the plan to the old rate, waived cancellation penalties, and applied a 30 dirham credit to the customer's bill.

evidence.text: Welcome to Zain customer service, my name is Mohammad, how can I help you today ya akhi?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, respectful, and helpful tone throughout the call, even when the customer was frustrated.

evidence.text: I am so sorry to hear that you're upset, momken tontny your phone number and account details please so I can check what happened?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration promptly and offered a sincere apology before proceeding to investigate.

evidence.text: I have cancelled the renewal penalty, reverted your plan to the old rate, and I applied a 30 dirham credit to your current bill for the inconvenience.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent fully resolved the customer's issue by reverting the plan, waiving penalties, and providing a credit, leaving the customer completely satisfied.

evidence.text: Let me check the system real quick... ah, I see here that the contract was renewed last month under the promotion plan, bas don't worry, let me see what options we have to fix this for you.
